Interface RequestExpectationManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractRequestExpectationManager, SimpleRequestExpectationManager, UnorderedRequestExpectationManager
public interface RequestExpectationManager
Encapsulates the behavior required to implement MockRestServiceServer including its public API (create expectations + verify/reset) along with an extra method for verifying actual requests.

该合约不会直接在应用程序中使用，但可以通过 `MockRestServiceServer` 构建器plugged进行自定义实现。

Since:
4.3
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev

  • Method Details

    • expectRequest

      ResponseActions expectRequest(ExpectedCount count, RequestMatcher requestMatcher)
      Set up a new request expectation. The returned ResponseActions is used to add more expectations and define a response.

      这是 `MockRestServiceServer.expect(ExpectedCount, RequestMatcher)` 的一个委托。

      Parameters:
      requestMatcher - 一个请求期望
      Returns:
      用于设定进一步的期望并定义响应。
      See Also:
      • MockRestServiceServer.expect(RequestMatcher)
      • MockRestServiceServer.expect(ExpectedCount, RequestMatcher)

    • verify

      void verify()
      Verify that all expectations have been met.

      这是 MockRestServiceServer.verify() 的委托。

      Throws:
      AssertionError - 如果未满足所有预期
      See Also:
      • MockRestServiceServer.verify()

    • verify

      void verify(Duration timeout)
      `verify()` 的变体，它会等待指定的时间，直到所有期望得到满足。这对于涉及异步请求的测试非常有用。
      Parameters:
      timeout - 等待所有期望得到满足的时间长度
      Throws:
      AssertionError - 如果未能在指定的超时时间内满足所有期望，或者在此之前的任何时间期望失败。
      Since:
      5.3.4

    • reset

      void reset()
      Reset the internal state removing all expectations and recorded requests.

      这是MockRestServiceServer.reset()的委托。

      See Also:
      • MockRestServiceServer.reset()

    • validateRequest

      ClientHttpResponse validateRequest(ClientHttpRequest request) throws IOException
      Validate the given actual request against the declared expectations. Is successful return the mock response to use or raise an error.

      这用于在 `MockRestServiceServer` 中针对实际请求。

      Parameters:
      request - 请求
      Returns:
      如果请求经过验证，则返回的响应。
      Throws:
      AssertionError - 当某些预期未满足时
      `IOException` - 如果出现任何验证错误
